title: Ten-stage scientific platform roadmap
status: Partially implemented; v1.7 adds bounded parameter fitting and software sanity checks; not a claim of complete research-grade validation
principles: No AI planner is included in this release; scientific engines come first.
Only models marked implemented are executable.
L1 means numerical computation and software checks, not empirical validation.
External sources listed are pointers; this release does not automatically download or validate their datasets.
Medical, cosmetic safety, clinical and regulatory decisions are out of scope.
Parameter fitting is exploratory and reports objective diagnostics without confidence intervals or identifiability claims.
The built-in validation suite is software-level sanity checking, not empirical model validation.

stages.name: Executable experiment engine
delivered: Existing protocol graph and material transfers retained
Model executions produce structured rows, checks, limitations and provenance
Generic experiment API and saved history retained
remaining: Fully couple every protocol step to stateful sample composition and reagent inventories
Physical hardware control and a full 3D digital twin are not implemented

stages.name: Equipment-aware virtual lab
delivered: Capacity/range validation
Illustrative pipette transfer uncertainty
Thermal-chamber perturbations
Synthetic instrument measurement uncertainty

stages.name: Uncertainty and statistics
delivered: Existing dataset profiling and enzyme uncertainty/sensitivity
Generic deterministic Monte Carlo parameter uncertainty for implemented solvers
Generic parameter sweeps
Reference-data comparison with selected model columns
Bounded deterministic least-squares parameter fitting against user-supplied x/y observations
Residual diagnostics (SSE, RMSE, MAE, descriptive R²) and explicit optimizer limitations
remaining: Correlated distributions, model discrepancy, parameter inference and formal identifiability analysis
Parameter confidence intervals, correlated errors, model discrepancy and formal identifiability

stages.name: Traceable scientific library
delivered: Five additional model records with assumptions and limitations
Official scientific-source pointers for BioModels, SBML, SED-ML, NIST Chemistry WebBook, EPA ECOTOX and PubMed
remaining: Sourced data/model ingestion with per-record license checks, bibliographic validation and independent benchmarks

stages.name: Biology and biochemistry
delivered: Enzyme kinetics and logistic population dynamics; imported SBML subset can represent supported reaction networks
remaining: Cellular regulation, metabolic networks, growth models calibrated to published data

stages.name: Medicine and neuroscience
delivered: Simple SIR dynamics and clearly labelled one-compartment pharmacokinetics teaching equation
Leaky integrate-and-fire neuron teaching model for basic excitability dynamics
remaining: Validated cancer, Alzheimer’s, electrophysiology or patient-specific models; no diagnosis or treatment claims

stages.name: Interdisciplinary domains
delivered: Chemistry reaction, environmental decay, heat transfer, ecology predator–prey, biology and medicine teaching models
One-compartment concentration decay teaching equation only; not a clinical model
remaining: Coupled multiphysics and chemistry/environment models with units and validated parameter sources
No disease-specific cancer or Alzheimer model has been implemented

stages.name: Research workflow and reporting
delivered: Local history, CSV profiling, JSON dossiers, sweeps, comparisons, protocol traces and report schema
Arrhenius model explicitly couples temperature to reaction kinetics at constant temperature
remaining: Publication-ready report generation, scalable job queue, richer plots and team collaboration

stages.name: Independent validation, then AI
delivered: Automated mathematical invariants and regression tests; reproducible seeded analyses
Repeatable software sanity suite covering ten executable solver models
remaining: Independent published benchmark suites and empirical validation; only after this should an AI planner be added
Independent reference benchmarks with traceable source data
External scientific review, convergence studies and domain-specific validation
AI integration remains deferred until scientific validation foundations are stronger
